1.1 Qualifying Spend. Qualifying Spend means freight charges (base freight, fuel, security surcharge and Annex D accessorials) on invoices dated in the period, net of all credit notes dated in the period whatever invoice they reference (rebate and improvement credits excepted). It excludes taxes (sales tax, GST), duties and disbursements, late fees, and rebate or improvement credits.

7.1 Volume rebate. The Carrier shall credit a rebate on each Quarter's Qualifying Spend (QS) at the tier reached: QS >= USD 61,000.00: 5%; QS >= USD 99,000.00: 7.5%; QS >= USD 164,000.00: 10%. The tier rate applies to all QS in the Quarter.
7.2 Thresholds. Rebate thresholds are in USD per Quarter.
7.3 Rebate credit. Rebate credit notes are issued within 45 days after Quarter end.
9.1 Annual improvement credit. Within 60 days after each anniversary of the Effective Date, the Carrier shall issue a credit of 1.99% of the prior Contract Year's Qualifying Spend.
